name: Ruby's Touch
description: An epitome of elegance and allure. Ruby's Touch features a sheer neckline and sleeves adorned with floral lace appliqués, along with a beautiful mermaid cut that contours the body gracefully. The hemline is ornamented with delicate ruffles and subtle pink embellishments, lending a feminine charm to the overall design.

name: Étoile Satinée
description: Featuring a mesmerizing mermaid silhouette that entrancingly accentuates the figure, flowing into a graceful train. The upper design is adorned with a soft bow shaped draped neckline and the subtle embellishments add a touch of regal sophistication.

name: Classic Elegance
description: A timeless white evening gown with clean lines and sophisticated draping. Features a fitted bodice with subtle gathering and a flowing train that creates an effortlessly elegant silhouette.

name: Pearl Cascade
description: Exquisite bridal gown featuring intricate lace appliqués and delicate pearl detailing. The long sleeves and high neckline create a sophisticated look while the fitted silhouette flows into a stunning train.

name: Moonlight Serenade
description: A captivating evening gown that embodies modern romance. The sleek silhouette and dramatic train create an unforgettable presence for special occasions.

name: Celestial Dreams
description: A breathtaking bridal masterpiece adorned with celestial-inspired beadwork and crystals. The sheer bodice creates an ethereal effect while maintaining elegant sophistication.
